title: 3lemetry
tagline: Telemetry dashboard DApps allowing Chain and Graph data to be interacted with in a Frame.
description: The telemetry dashboard for web3 DApps provides users with a comprehensive interface for monitoring and interacting with data from the local blockchain and Graph. Through a simple terminal-based display, users can seamlessly navigate through wallet information, with each wallet item numbered and selectable. Upon selection, users can trigger actions by pressing Enter, facilitating efficient interaction with the displayed data. This intuitive interface empowers users to efficiently monitor system metrics and wallet data, enhancing their ability to analyze and manage their web3 DApp environments effectively.
how_its_made: The telemetry dashboard for web3 DApps is built using a combination of cutting-edge technologies to deliver a seamless user experience. Leveraging the power of XMPT for blockchain integration, Pinata for decentralized file storage, and Frames.js for frame-based data visualization, the dashboard brings together disparate sources of data into a unified interface. Through XMPT's robust capabilities, the dashboard accesses and retrieves data from the local blockchain, while Pinata ensures secure and decentralized storage of files essential for DApp functionality. Frames.js, with its advanced frame-based visualization techniques, enables users to interact with data in an intuitive and visually engaging manner. This sophisticated architecture allows for real-time monitoring and interaction with system metrics and wallet data, empowering users to make informed decisions and optimize their web3 DApp environments effectively.
